newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police find Danish skiers' bodies in Alps.
newsitem.headline: French police find Danish skiers' bodies in Alps.

text.p: French police found the bodies of two Danish skiers on Monday at the foot of an Alpine cliff near the Morzine resort in Haute-Savoie, the paramilitary gendarmerie said.
The names of the two men were not released but their ages were given as 26 and 34. They had apparently strayed away from marked-out ski runs, police said.
A search was launched after members of the skiers' tour group alerted authorities late on Sunday.
